**v2.2.1 is released:** https://github.com/cv/pi-action/releases/tag/v2.2.1

### What shipped (`v2.2.0..v2.2.1`)
- #36: fixes #35. A response cut off by `max_tokens` no longer ends the run.
- #41: fixes #38. The action no longer installs `commit-msg`/`prepare-commit-msg` hooks in the target repository.
- #37: how to read the thread with git, shown in the workflow log and job summary.
- #34: the docs reorganization into `docs/`.
- #40 and two dogfood `ci:` commits: they change only this repository's workflows, not the action, so the release notes leave them out.

Nothing on `main` looked wrong for a patch release. #37 is a small addition that only adds log output, and you listed it in the issue.

### Verification (local, on `main` at 440b5eb, after `npm ci`)
Pushes made with this token don't trigger CI, so these local runs are the release's verification.
- `npm run check`: exit 0. Typecheck passed. oxlint reported `Found 0 warnings and 0 errors.`, and oxfmt and lint:actions passed. knip passed, and jscpd reported `Found 0 clones.`
- `npm test`: **26 test files, 330 tests passed**.
- `npm run coverage`: 330 passed. All files: 97.47% statements, 92.89% branches, 96.64% functions, 97.63% lines.
- The repository's pre-commit and pre-push hooks (test, lint, commitlint, coverage) also passed on the release commit.

### Refs
| Ref | Points to |
|---|---|
| `main` | c5ae856f407ec1f9b41c3c27cc653e81ad908808 (`chore: release 2.2.1`) |
| `v2.2.1` (annotated, `v2.2.1`) | c5ae856f407ec1f9b41c3c27cc653e81ad908808 |
| `v2` (annotated, `v2`, moved from 9a1ef55) | c5ae856f407ec1f9b41c3c27cc653e81ad908808 |

The release is published as **Latest**. It is not a draft and not a pre-release. I didn't move or delete any `vX.Y.Z` tag.

Two problems happened during the run, and I fixed both:
- I first pushed `v2` as a lightweight tag. The old `v2` was annotated, so I made it annotated again (`-m "v2"`) and pushed it again within a minute. It still points to the same commit.
- `gh release create` first published the release with an empty body. A minute later I filled in the notes with `gh release edit`.

Also: #41's PR describes a `commitlint` CI job patch that is still waiting for a maintainer, because the App can't push workflow files. It changes only CI and isn't part of this release.

I'm leaving this issue open for you to close.
